author: DiviXion
body:
This map is horrible. No offence to the creators of the map but it's extremely bad for gameplay. Now before you spam replies on why it isn't, I'll outline WHY it's bad.
1. The map is way too small.
For a map that is that small, the player count needs to be lowered. There's barely any space to build in and there's nearly no strategic use of the map. You can tunnel but soon enough, you'll end up tunneling the whole map up. You can skybridge but sure enough, you won't have space to land on.

2. It's a kill farm.
"Oh but it's good because I can get kills easily!"
I don't see the point in this map if it's used for kill farming. Sit at the monument and you can rack up a lot of kills from rushers. For the sake of Nebula, please don't add kill farming maps to DTM. This map is by far one of the easiest maps to kill farm on as far as I've seen.

3. It's a huge stalemate.
This map can go on for hours on end without stopping. Sure, longs games time to time may be fun but this map can go for 5 hours if played legitimately. It's a never-ending process of rush and get killed. The whole map will be dug out and then it'll just be who can kill the defender first and break that monument. Even a team effort can't pull through a win if the opponent is defending properly. Most maps allow team pushes to break down the enemy but this simply does nothing,

4. The spawn is way too close to everything.
You spawn and run out for 2 seconds and you're already in the battlefield. Not some kind of 'it's part of the battlefield' but in the actual war zone. The spawn takes up most of the space and you can access anything in a few seconds. Not to mention that rushers don't get a chance to even rush. You successfully killed 4 enemies and you're out to bridge. You bridge for 3 seconds and then you see arrows flying past. You run back and all 4 enemies are running back to you. It's stupid in general because this is the exact reason why people get rushed. The only time you might get a chance is when you're at the Monument but then again, getting there is nearly impossible in general.

That's all I can say right now but I honestly this map needs a rework or a removal from the rotation. I don't mind if you disagree with me but if you do, constructive criticism is appreciated. Thanks in advance and don't forget this is MY opinion.

title: About Justice I

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
1. The map is way too small.
Intended, from what I know. The sequels are built larger and are made as improvements of it, but the original Justice is a classic and at the time, there were many maps that had low player counts, thus this following. I agree with an expansion, but hopefully nothing too drastic.

2. It's a kill farm.
To be fair, it depends on how you play it. Almost all the maps are killfarms and the design for these maps is up to the author. Players find different tactics every day, and unfortunately a lot of maps are prone to kill farming. It's no different here than OCN or ActionPvP or anything, because every map has ways to farm kills. The only thing I see wrong with this is that people like to killfarm outside of spawn.

3. It's a huge stalemate.
I've only seen the matches go on for at most 2 hours. This goes in hand with size issues, as if there was more points of access it'd be easier to get to the monument. Right now, the only thing you can use to get to the monuments other than spawn is U-bridging, and again that goes in hand with size yeah. Some side islands would be nice.

4. The spawn is way too close to everything.
Well, I suppose. Size issue again; if there were more points of access such as islands, it'd be easier to scatter out and put things in other spots.

All I am seeing is that really that the map needs to be expanded. That'd fix all 4 issues, no?

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Justice I is great as it is. There are many many many ways to get past a kill farm. Also, if you want this map gone because of kill farming maybe Quintus, Consilium, etc. should be edited/gone too. And no, it isn't a stalemate at all. All you have to do is bridge over to the top of their spawn and bridge to the monuments. 

I believe Justice I is fine as it is.

replies.body:
"Bridge over the top of their spawn and bridge to the monuments."
It's 100000x harder when you actually attempt to do it. You get spotted easily and if you go too high, you'll end up dying from fall damage. The map is so small that you can see anyone skybridge and getting the Monument is insanely difficult, even with 1 person properly defending.

replies.author: DiviXion
replies.body:
I know a challenge is good but this map, which I'm absolutely sure you made along with someone else, is not deemed as a challenge in my perspective. If there are defenders, even a team rush won't help. I'm not saying this map is bad but I'm saying that it needs a rework. As another Map Dev stated earlier, Justice I needs to be expanded and made into a larger map somehow. 

Not only that but currently, the problem exacerbates with multiple skybridges being built and without knowing it, the whole sky is filled with blocks. Then you attempt to tunnel through and underbridge. Sure, it works at the start but when you start underbridging to that monument, you're going to get shot off multiple times. Then you go back and there's no bridge and now there are defenders. The problem begins.

There isn't a plethora of options within this map. If you choose to rush, it's mostly by go the same path until you went through every strategy after 20 minutes. Defend and you have all the time in the world to finish off your amazing defense. Now, this map shouldn't be made easier but a map that is larger will definitely expand the potential for extra bridges or unseen and hidden strategies. There's plenty of options you have that can still keep the challenging part but make the gameplay a lot better overall.
